|translation='''Title:''' R2 Sensor Array.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy on any R-unit droid. Your character at the same place may move and flee as a react from a creature attack. Also, add 3 to search party destiny at the same or adjacent location.

'''Lore:'''
A very common R2 accessory made by Industrial Automaton. It can sense radiation strength and nearby life-forms.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed title is R2のセンサー・アレイ.
